text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Arabian Insurance Group ARIG is to establish a $50 million company for health and general insurance, a company official said.
- Filipino workers in Bahrain and other Gulf Arab states are sending home about $500 million a year, a banker at the Bank of the Philippine Islands said.
- Abu Dhabi is planning to invest about $3.7 billion dirhams ($1 billion) to expand its main seaport and build a new harbour, an official said on Sunday.
